# 2026-11-14: App 1.0.6: the Q&A tab, topics matched on the phone, a lighter Explore (TR-054)

Commit `60cdd7b` ("Major refinements in teh app with google sign in support"), by a developer, pushed straight to
`main` on 2026-11-14 with no branch and no pull request. These docs were written afterwards on
`chore/docs-app-1-0-6`, merged as pull request 45 (merge `45b62ce`) ([plan 18](../plan/18-qa-tab-and-lighter-explore.md) records the product changes). Only the
mobile app changed; the backend deploy that a push to `main` is meant to run had nothing new to deploy.

## Problem

The commit gives no reasons. Read from the diff and its comments:
- the Community tab answers questions, so it is now called what it is ("Q&A");
- a topic chip showed only questions saved under that category, so a housing question saved as General never
  appeared under Housing;
- Explore repeated what other tabs already show (homes, a question, stories, a poll);
- EAS Build could not find `google-services.json` (git-ignored, so not uploaded) or `@expo/metro-config` (not a
  direct dependency under pnpm).

## Change

**Version.** 1.0.4 → 1.0.6 in `app.config.js` and `package.json`.

**Build.**
- `android.googleServicesFile` reads `GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON` (an EAS file variable) and falls back to
  `./google-services.json`. A local build still uses the file.
- `shamefully-hoist` in `.npmrc` and `shamefullyHoist: true` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`: `node_modules` is laid out
  flat. Run `pnpm install` in `frontend/apps/mobile/` after pulling.
- `metro.transformer.js` resolves `@expo/metro-config/build/babel-transformer` from where `expo` is installed.

**Q&A tab** (`app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx`, `app/(tabs)/community/index.tsx`).
- Tab label, header title and page title say "Q&A". The route stays `community/index`.
- A topic is matched on the phone by `questionMatchesTopic`: the saved category, a tag equal to the topic, or the
  keyword scorer (`scoreForCategory` ≥ 2, the one that suggests a topic when asking). General takes questions
  saved as General and any question that scores for no other topic.
- With a topic chosen, the list asks the server for every question in the city (no `category`), 50 per page (the
  API's maximum), and drops those that do not match. Without a topic, pages stay at 20.

**Explore** (`src/features/explore/components/ExploreBento.tsx`). A `SHOW` object hides four tiles: Homes, the
trending question (its request is no longer sent), Stories nearby and the Poll. The right-hand column is left out
when both of its tiles are hidden. Setting a flag to `true` brings a tile back.

**Food** (`app/(tabs)/food/index.tsx`). The "Rated 4.5+" tile is hidden by `const topCount = 0`. The Top rated
chip still filters.

**Look.**
- Login and sign-up: the logo and "comlinkr" wordmark are bigger and centred; sign-up's Back button is placed
  absolutely at the left so the logo stays centred.
- App header: the avatar has no gradient ring; it is a plain 34 px circle.
- Side menu: the logo and wordmark at the top.

**Google sign-in.** Nothing in the sign-in code changed. The commit only lets an EAS build carry the Google
Services file.

## Notes for the next change

- **Topic pages can be thin.** A page of 50 may keep few or none, and the list loads the next page only when the
  end is reached; a quiet topic in a busy city may show a short list or several loads in a row. The same question
  can appear under two topics (saved as Housing, worded about food). `mapTopicToCategory` in
  `src/api/community-qa.api.ts` and the API's `category` filter are no longer used by this screen.
- **The local release APK and Google sign-in.** `scripts\build-release-apk.cmd` signs with
  `android/app/debug.keystore`, SHA-1 `5E:8F:16:06:2E:A3:CD:2C:4A:0D:54:78:76:BA:A6:F3:8C:AB:F6:25`. The
  `google-services.json` in the repository (25 October) lists two Android OAuth clients for `com.comlinkr.app`,
  with SHA-1s starting `7E:30:07` and `A6:24:1A`, and not this one. Unless it was added in the Google Cloud console
  since, Google sign-in in that APK fails with `DEVELOPER_ERROR` (code 10). Register the SHA-1 (Firebase, Project
  settings, Android app, Add fingerprint); no rebuild is needed. TR-055.
- The web client ID in the mobile `.env` matches the Web client in `google-services.json`, and the local backend
  accepts it through `GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID`. Production's backend `.env` was not seen.
- `title="Q&A"scrollY={…}` in `community/index.tsx` lacks a space. It compiles; tidy it with the next change there.

## How it was checked

- **By the author:** nothing recorded (no pull request, no build note, no run log).
- **Afterwards, 2026-11-15:** read the diff; mobile `pnpm typecheck` at `60cdd7b` passes (pnpm 12 reinstalled
  `node_modules` first, now hoisted). Checked the API accepts `limit=50` (`PaginationDto` has `@Max(50)`).
- **Not walked on the phone.** To walk: the Q&A tab with each topic chip in a city with many questions and in one
  with none; Explore's bento with and without a next event; Food's hero tiles; login and sign-up in light and dark
  mode; the side menu; Google sign-in on a release APK once TR-055 is done.
